description: This file defines a custom exception class `AttendanceServiceException` within the `OrangeHRM\Attendance\Exception` namespace. The class provides static methods to create specific exception instances related to attendance punching errors in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AttendanceServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for attendance service errors, providing static methods to generate specific exception messages related to punching in/out and date/time validation.

methods.name: punchOutAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of AttendanceServiceException indicating a punch out attempt when employee is already punched out.

methods.name: punchInAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of AttendanceServiceException indicating a punch in attempt when employee is already punched in.

methods.name: punchOutTimeBehindThanPunchInTime
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating punch out time is earlier than punch in time.

methods.name: punchInOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating overlapping punch-in times were found.

methods.name: punchOutOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating overlapping punch-out times were found.

methods.name: invalidDateTime
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating provided date and time are invalid.

methods.name: punchOutDateTimeNull
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating punch out date and time should not be null.

methods.name: deletableAttendanceRecordIdsEmpty
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating no IDs were found for deletion.

methods.name: invalidTimezoneDetails
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating valid timezone offset and name must be provided.
